name: Hope Macaulay
signal_summary: Northern Ireland label built on hand-knitting by named local knitters, sold in limited quantities. Production is fully manual, so demand outruns supply. Store never states lead times and has no production FAQ, which on a made-to-order model is the single biggest driver of support load and abandoned carts.
signal_quote: Joyful fashion, mindfully made and crafted with care in limited quantities.
tech_gaps: Lead times never stated despite made-to-order model|No production-timeline FAQ|Contact details buried on a separate page|Hand-knit only — no machine-knit line for scalable styles
